headline: Public Law 118-161 authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal to Everett Alvarez Jr. to recognize his service to the nation.
what_it_does: The law provides for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to Everett Alvarez Jr. It honors his service to the country. The official summary does not describe any other requirements or benefits.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 23, 2024. The summary does not list a separate effective date.
